Part 6 of Block Diffusion Rooflines (Previous: 5 · The whole picture | Next: 7 · Worked examples)

The propositions give closed forms under simplifying assumptions. The calculator instead evaluates every pass of a generation with the exact accounting of the appendix, for any accelerator, model, attention layout and decoding setup. It reports both throughputs, the AR batch that matches TD, the memory each decoder needs, and the maps of Part 5 for the chosen setting; the page address records the setting, so it can be shared.

Accelerator specs
Model specs

Layer \(i\) is global when \(i\) is a multiple of "Global every" (1: all global). "Window" is in tokens.

Sparse attention

\(\eta\) is the fraction of a canvas's selections that are independent; 1/\(b\) means every query selects the same blocks.

Throughput and gain cover the whole generation, during which the context grows from \(P\) to \(P + G\). The regime label and the per-pass table use the context halfway through, \(P + G/2\).
